entities.name: João do Rio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: João do Rio was the pseudonym of the Brazilian journalist, short-story writer and playwright  João Paulo Emílio Cristóvão dos Santos Coelho Barreto, a Brazilian author and journalist of African descent. He was elected on May 7, 1910 for the chair # 26 of Brazilian Academy of Letters.
